name: brew
purpose: Homebrew — macOS terminal package manager to find, download, and install CLI programs.
explanation: Automates installing, updating, and managing command-line software packages on macOS so they become available in your terminal.

parameters.description: Downloads and installs one or more named packages.

example: brew install cowsay fortune sl lolcat
expectedOutput: (Downloads and installs cowsay, fortune, sl, and lolcat)
whenToUse: When a command fails with 'command not found' on macOS and needs to be installed.
commonMistakes: Trying to run brew on Linux or Windows (use apt/yum/pacman/flatpak on Linux, chocolatey on Windows).
